name: Astral Shadow-Clans
identity: Dark-tech raider clans and cyber-ronin swordsmen on blade-skiffs. Glass cannons that grow stronger as the battle bleeds: every enemy unit they destroy adds Agony they spend to empower their next strike.

rules.name: Agony Harvest
rules.description: Start the battle with 2 Agony (max 4). Gain 1 each time an enemy unit is destroyed. When a unit activates, spend 1 Agony to Empower it until the end of the activation: re-roll Hit rolls, +1 PEN in melee and +2″ to Charge rolls. Agony is your own resource; it is never placed on enemy units.

rules.name: Gamble — All-In Assassination
rules.description: Once per battle, spend ALL Agony (minimum 2) when a unit activates: its weapons gain [PRECISION] and [SHREDDING WOUNDS] this activation; you cannot gain Agony again until the End of Round. (Risk: resource.)

detachments.name: Skysplinter Raiders
detachments.playstyle: Skiffs and barges deliver strike teams, then fly on.

rules.name: Skysplinter Assault
rules.description: Units that disembarked this round get +1 to Wound and [CRASHING].

enhancements.name: Umbral Veil
enhancements.description: **Master of the Astral Edge** only. WARD 3+ until the first time a WARD roll of 1 is made, then no WARD.

enhancements.name: Agony-Tap
enhancements.description: **Flesh-Sculptor** only. Start the battle with 3 Agony.

stratagems.name: Lightning Raid
stratagems.effect: Embarked units may disembark after its move and still Charge.

detachments.name: Cyber-Ronin
detachments.playstyle: Sword-saints and duelists in the open, no transports.

rules.name: Way of the Blade
rules.description: Melee weapons gain [STRIKE FIRST] on a round the unit charged; units that spend Agony also gain [PRECISION].

enhancements.name: Ancestral Blade
enhancements.description: **Cyber-Ronin Sword-Saint** only. +1 Damage in melee on a round he charged.

enhancements.name: Duelist's Discipline
enhancements.description: **Cyber-Ronin Duelists** only. Enemies get −1 to Hit them in melee.

stratagems.name: Draw and Cut
stratagems.effect: Its Retaliation Strike resolves before the charger fights.

stratagems.turn: A unit destroys an enemy Leader

stratagems.name: Bladestorm

rules.name: Venom
rules.description: Ranged weapons with [IMPALING HITS] also gain [ANTI-INFANTRY 4+]; Flesh-Sculptors heal D3 MIGHT on the attached unit at the End of Round.

enhancements.name: Elixir of Agony
enhancements.description: **Flesh-Sculptor** only. Friendly units within 6″ get +1 to Wound in melee on a round they charged.

enhancements.name: Hex-Venom Rounds
enhancements.description: **Shadow-Kabar Raiders** only. +1 PEN with ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Toxin Cloud
stratagems.effect: Units hit suffer −1″ MOV until the End of Round.

stratagems.name: Pain-Fuelled
stratagems.effect: Heal 1 MIGHT on the empowered unit.

stratagems.name: Lethal Dose
stratagems.turn: A unit targets a Class 1 unit
